findings: The exception is limited to APPLICATION_CLIENT + service.order_entry + orders.submit_approved_target.
Registration and dispatch still require the exact trusted PrincipalGrant identity and ResourceGrant instance, port, scope_ref, full WireScope, and operation.
Every other strategy-scoped write continues to require its existing trusted group policy.

The focused regression covers forged actor and delegate, cross-account, wrong selector, ordinary orders.submit registration denial, and ordinary orders.submit invocation denial on the approved registration.
review_limit: This review and the fixed-source unit node do not establish AFI HTTP/Execution Host integration, real Risk admission, real provider/account behavior, or full AFI07 acceptance.
